games.name: Wheel Machine Simulator
games.desc:
Get your spin right. Master the machine.

Step into the grease-stained boots of a professional wheel launcher in Wheel Machine Simulator. Forget the open road—this is about raw, mechanical precision. Calibrate your angular velocity, adjust the magnetic rail aligners, and pull the release lever. Whether you’re aiming for distance, accuracy, or spectacular destruction, every launch is a physics-based puzzle. Build your ultimate wheel, upgrade your machine, and chase the perfect trajectory. How far can you make it roll?
